hourly_logs.activity: Toolbox safety meeting conducted. Reviewed H2S hazards, high-pressure line checks, and PPE protocols.
Rigged up 2-7/8" workstring. Tripped in hole. Tagged hard obstruction (paraffin wax/sand bridge) at 1,450m depth.
Hooked up hot oil pumping unit. Pumped 60 bbl heated lease crude (85°C) with 150 liters xylene wax dispersant down tubing at 1.8 bpm. Circulation established.
Circulated dissolved wax to test pit. Ran mechanical scraper to 2870m with smooth torque and zero drag.
Pressure tested production tubing to 1,500 psi for 15 minutes. Recorded zero leak-off. Chart certified.
Secured wellhead. Connected flowline to Geleki GGS-2 header. Handed over well to production shift in-charge.

daily_workover_report.outcome_summary: Success — Restored production flow by +34.6 BOPD above baseline.
